name: Household Ledger - Budget Alert Listener (SCAFFOLD, not deployed)

parameters.content:
## SCAFFOLD — NOT DEPLOYED
Modeled on the pattern in household-ledger-architecture.md §3: 'always-on, mirrors the Telegram Approval Listener. After each list update, if over budget, message Graham/Rutendo via Telegram.'

HOW THIS GETS CALLED: this workflow is a sub-workflow, not its own trigger. Wire an 'Execute Workflow' node into Household_Ledger_List_Budget_Webhook_Agent.json immediately after its 'Compute Totals' node, passing { total, budget, remaining, cadence } as input. This is the same sub-workflow-call shape used elsewhere in the existing n8n fleet (e.g. ME101's 'SELECT_ME_AFTER_IMPORT' sub-workflow pattern) rather than inventing a new shape.

SETUP TODOs:
1. Add the 'Execute Workflow' node to the List/Budget Webhook Agent (not done here — that file isn't touched by this scaffold, to avoid modifying something you may already be editing).
2. Connect a Telegram bot credential + chat ID (REPLACE_WITH_ placeholders below). Open Decision #3 (architecture.md §8): reuse the existing Beautiful Nature Scenes Approval bot/chat, or a separate bot for household purchases?

NOT BUILT (deliberately, see architecture.md §3's own 'could optionally' wording): the YES/NO-style pause/resume reply loop (e.g. 'OK keep going over' vs 'trim it'). This scaffold is one-way notification only — a v2 could add a Wait node + reply-router workflow, same shape as the Check-In Agent's pause/resume pair, if Graham wants that later.
